description: This Java source file defines the class CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor, which implements a visitor pattern to traverse policy tree nodes, evaluate permissions for subjects and resources, and collect affected subjects based on permission effects.

classes.name: CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses policy tree nodes to evaluate permissions and collect affected subjects based on specified permissions.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating permissions for a specific subject within resource nodes.

methods.name: CollectEffectedSubjectsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Traverses a policy tree node, delegating to subject or resource node handlers.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles a subject node, creating an evaluator for the subject.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles a resource node, aggregating permissions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the collected affected subjects after traversal.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Aggregates permissions from a resource node for a specific subject.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Determines the position of a resource node relative to the target pointer.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates permissions to determine if a subject is granted or revoked based on weighted permissions.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyRevoked
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively revoked for a subject.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyGranted
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively granted for a subject.
